name: AliasVault
description: AliasVault is an open-source, end-to-end encrypted password manager and email alias service. It features a zero-knowledge architecture where your master password never leaves your device, a built-in SMTP server for alias email addresses, browser extensions with autofill, and native iOS/Android apps.

notes.text: The installation builds AliasVault from source (Rust core, React web client, .NET services) and takes 15–30 minutes. Do not interrupt the process.
The admin password is auto-generated during installation. Show it with: cat ~/aliasvault.creds
All settings live in /opt/aliasvault/.env (same option names as upstream .env.example). Apply changes with: systemctl restart aliasvault.target
Behind a reverse proxy with TLS termination: set FORCE_HTTPS_REDIRECT=false and TRUSTED_PROXIES=<proxy IP> in /opt/aliasvault/.env, then point the proxy at http://<container-ip>:80.
To receive alias emails, point your domain MX record to this server (ports 25/587) and set PRIVATE_EMAIL_DOMAINS in /opt/aliasvault/.env.
